title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization in logistic regression is used to prevent overfitting by penalizing large coefficients. When the regularization parameter \( \lambda \) is set to a large value, it forces the coefficients to be smaller.

title: Effect of Large \( \lambda \) on Decision Boundary
text: With a large \( \lambda \), the model will have smaller coefficients, which can lead to a more vertical or horizontal decision boundary, depending on which coefficient is being regularized more.

title: Analyzing the Figures
text: Look at the figures and identify which one has a decision boundary that is more vertical. This would indicate a smaller coefficient for the sad emoji count, which is affected by a large \( \lambda \).
